failure_reasons.control_failure: one or more repaired controls failed
failure_reasons.did_not_beat_frozen: trainable shared model did not improve over exact frozen same architecture
failure_reasons.heldout_generalization_bottleneck: micro-overfit passed but held-out ladder gates did not
failure_reasons.micro_overfit_failure: scoring, labels, masks, gradients, or tokenization remain suspect
failure_reasons.no_meaningful_ablation_drop: view ablation did not remove enough accuracy
failure_reasons.shortcut_baseline_above_chance: candidate-only, length, action-stat, metadata, or candidate-stat shortcut exceeded chance window
